x-execution-rules: Default disabled; explicit per-project/account versioned whitelist and limits expire within 30 days.
Preview is immutable, actor-bound, capped at 100 unexpired per actor/project and valid for up to 10 minutes.
Each-operation confirmation requires current customer manage authority; no Codex or Admin confirmation endpoint.
Within-policy execution requires an explicitly saved policy; Codex may prepare only within its current tools and project authority.
One unresolved target per tenant/account/budget across connections/projects.
Exact source re-read, auth/policy revalidation, durable dispatch admission, one physical mutate with no retry.
Dispatched lease expiry and transport ambiguity become unknown, never queued.
A matching current value is an observation, not causal proof. Manual closure requires a fresh 10-minute observation, reason and explicit acknowledgement.
AEAD local receipt outbox precedes DB persistence; recovery only records the captured response. Simultaneous loss of both storage systems can leave unknown evidence.
Google Ads provides no object CAS lock. A concurrent external change between final read and mutate remains possible.
Revocation or policy changes cannot recall an already committed dispatch admission.
Average daily budget is not a maximum daily charge. Provider spend is separate from company AI billing.
Existing admin roles never auto-gain the three new permission keys. Monetary bounded grants remain HKD; other currencies require a matching grant without a monetary cap.
